use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: The C2 JU exchanges IFF/SIF transponder data with other JUs by using the applicable J-series messages: Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages when available, and special-meaning codes in J7.5 (ACT=3) messages.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU exchanges IFF/SIF transponder data with other JUs by using the applicable J-series messages: Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages when available, and special-meaning codes in J7.5 (ACT=3) messages.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU transmits IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI=0) messages when available to another JU, thereby completing that exchange.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU has IFF/SIF transponder data to exchange with another JU and the applicable J-series message is available.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been exchanged via the applicable J-series message.
in_scope_actions: Transmit IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI=0) messages when available
Use J7.5 (ACT=2) messages to exchange codes that have special meaning for implementing JUs
Exchange IFF/SIF modes and codes via the five IFF/SIF exchange functional areas
excluded_adjacent_actions: Post-exchange consequences or downstream use cases not part of the literal exchange action
Administrative or configuration processes outside the IFF/SIF data exchange
variant_dimensions: Message/data type: standard Modes I/II/III codes via J3.1/J3.5 vs special-meaning codes via J7.5
Functional area: IFF/SIF Surveillance Data Reporting, Unique Mode II Code Protection, Clearing IFF/SIF Data, IFF/SIF Difference Resolution, IFF/SIF Update Request

claims.content: C2 JU
IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III codes) must be available to the C2 JU.
For the J7.5 (ACT=3) special code reporting function, the C2 JU must have implemented the special code capability.
The C2 JU must hold the special code information before transmitting it.

The use case is triggered when IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III surveillance data becomes available for exchange via J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages, when a J7.5 message with ACT=0 (Clear), ACT=1 (Difference Report), ACT=2 (Update Request), or ACT=3 (Special Code) is used for IFF/SIF data management and reporting, when an operator initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message, or when the R² unit reports a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required IFF/SIF Surveillance data report.
The C2 JU transmits IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) in the J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages when available.
The C2 JU, as the JU with R², is responsible for reporting IFF/SIF data in conjunction with periodic surveillance data.
The C2 JU periodically transmits the IFF/SIF surveillance data (Modes I, II, and III codes) in the J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) message to report the valid data held for the track.
Other JUs without R² monitor the IFF/SIF surveillance data reported by the C2 JU.

Diverges from Step 1: Instead of transmitting IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0), the C2 JU may transmit a Special Code message (J7.5 with ACT=3) to exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes.

Diverges from Step 1: Instead of transmitting its own available IFF/SIF data, the C2 JU may transmit an IFF/SIF Update Request message (J7.5 with ACT=2), initiated by operator action, to request updated transponder data from another unit; receiving units respond by transmitting their local data codes.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of reporting valid data in the periodic J3.1/J3.5 surveillance report, the C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report to report a difference in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix; this may be initiated by operator action at any time.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of continuing to periodically report valid IFF/SIF data, the C2 JU, as a JU with R², may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear message to clear one or more modes on the specified track; this results in no IFF/SIF data being held on that track and causes the JU to stop transmitting the periodic J3 message containing the continuation word for that track.

Diverges from Step 4: If the C2 JU receives a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear message from another JU, it automatically sets the designated mode(s) for the specified track to No Data status; acceptance or rejection of a Mode IV Clear message may be automatic or by operator determination.

Diverges from Step 3: Instead of reporting valid data, the C2 JU, as the R² unit, may spontaneously report a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required IFF/SIF Surveillance data report (J3.XC1); receiving units holding valid nonzero data respond as required by the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.
Diverges from Step 3: If locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from IFF/SIF data being reported in the PPLI message, the C2 JU shall report the locally derived data.

missing_aspects: Unique Mode II Code Protection alternative flow

claims.content: Diverges from Step 4: If the C2 JU receives a J3.XC1 'NO DATA' report (value 0) in the applicable Mode Code field for one or more modes while it holds local nonzero IFF/SIF data, it may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.

Diverges from Step 4: If locally entered IFF/SIF data at the C2 JU changes from zero to nonzero, or from one nonzero value to another nonzero value, the C2 JU may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.

Diverges from Step 4: If the C2 JU operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert, the operator has the following manual actions at his disposal for attempting resolution: update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; initiate a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear message (any mode); initiate a J7.5 (ACT=1) IFF/SIF Difference Report (any mode); change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; decorrelate local data from remote data, causing assignment of a new track number to local data; or clear the operator alert (any mode).

Diverges from Step 3: If the R² C2 JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1. The conflict is to be resolved by manual means.

Diverges from Step 4: If a conflict is indicated to the C2 JU when it is a non-R² JU, the C2 JU shall inhibit transmission of the J7.0 (ACT=1) until the surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 0.

missing_aspects: Explicit definition of the exception branch termination or exit state.
Explicit confirmation that clearing the alert constitutes the completion of the exception branch.
Explicit definition of the exception branch exit state.

claims.content: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been successfully exchanged in the applicable J-series message (e.g., J3.1/J3.5 for surveillance data or J7.5 for management actions).
A Valid Data condition is reported by entering the nonzero code in the applicable Mode Code field of the J3 continuation word.
If the exchange was performed via a J7.5 (ACT=2) Update Request message, the receiving units have responded by transmitting their local data codes.
If the exchange was performed via a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report transmission, the reported difference has been communicated to relevant units.

If a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message was transmitted and accepted, the designated mode(s) for the specified track are set to No Data status on all receiving JUs, and periodic J3 transmissions containing continuation words for that track cease.
